name: autosomal dominant vitreoretinochoroidopathy
description: Autosomal dominant vitreoretinochoroidopathy (ADVIRC) is a genetic vitreous-retinal disease characterized by ocular developmental anomalies such as microcornea, a shallow anterior chamber, glaucoma and cataract. Abnormal chorioretinal pigmentation is present, usually lying between the vortex veins and the ora serrata for 360 degrees.
